<thought>Based on the measurement (6.667 Ω) and the note that there are two resistors where one is twice the other, the only simple configuration that matches the measured resistance is a parallel connection of a 10 Ω resistor and a 20 Ω resistor (1/10 + 1/20 = 0.15 S → 6.667 Ω). Therefore the subnetwork consists of two parallel resistors R1 = 10 Ω and R2 = 20 Ω between nodes A and X1.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 10.0, "R2": 20.0}, "connections": [["A", "X1", "R1"], ["A", "X1", "R2"]]}</final_answer>
